maddeler.e:
أتمركز (form IIq)
# أَتَمَرْكَزُ (ʔatamarkazu) /ʔa.ta.mar.ka.zu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَمَرْكَزَ (tamarkaza)
# أَتَمَرْكَزَ (ʔatamarkaza) /ʔa.ta.mar.ka.za/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَمَرْكَزَ (tamarkaza)
# أَتَمَرْكَزْ (ʔatamarkaz) /ʔa.ta.mar.kaz/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَمَرْكَزَ (tamarkaza)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
